$comment: Order 25: the GitHub OIDC deploy identity of the workload account (role kauro-deploy/kauro-<env>-image-publisher). It pushes worker images to the one repository and reads them back; it changes no infrastructure, no IAM and no data. Terraform is applied in the owner's administrator session (procedures/PROVISIONING.md).
